requirements.title: Note-Taking App
requirements.description: An application for creating, organizing, and managing notes.

features.name: Create Notes
features.description: Allows users to create and save text-based notes.

features.name: Organize Notes
features.description: Enables users to categorize or tag notes for better organization.

features.name: Search Notes
features.description: Provides a search functionality to quickly find specific notes.

requirements.target_users: Individuals looking for a simple tool to manage their notes.
requirements.data_requirements: Requires storage for saving and retrieving user notes.

tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
创建笔记API
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记组织功能
实现笔记搜索功能

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database model for notes with fields like title, content, timestamp, and tags.
T1.notes: Ensure the model supports scalability and flexibility for future features.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs for CRUD operations on notes using a backend framework like Django or Express.
T2.notes: Include proper authentication and validation mechanisms.

T3.implementation_approach: Create a responsive frontend page using a framework like React or Vue to display, create, and edit notes.
T3.notes: Focus on user-friendly design and seamless integration with the API.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement functionality to organize notes into folders or categories, with drag-and-drop support if possible.
T4.notes: Ensure the organization structure is intuitive and easy to navigate.

T5.implementation_approach: Add a search feature using full-text search or keyword matching to quickly find notes.
T5.notes: Optimize for performance, especially for large datasets.
